                                                       Regular Meeting Agenda
Manjusha Kulkarni, President

                                    Wednesday, June 17, 2026
                                          1:00 p.m.
                                      City Hall Room 1070
                         200 North Spring Street, Los Angeles CA 90012
                         ________________________________________________________________

  This meeting will be broadcast live via Zoom. The meeting link is zoomgov.com/j/1617884780, and
  the meeting passcode is 267913. The live audio for this meeting may also be heard by calling
  (669) 254-5252 or toll free (833) 568-8864. Enter meeting ID 161 788 4780 followed by #. Press #
  again when prompted for participant ID.

  Public comments may be provided by email to ethics.commission@lacity.org, in person, by clicking the
  “raise hand” button in the Zoom meeting, or by pressing *9 once admitted to the meeting by phone.

Opening Items

1.      Call to order.

2.      Multiple agenda item comment.
        All public comment will be taken at this time for agenda items and for issues that are not on the agenda but
        are within the Ethics Commission’s jurisdiction. THIS WILL BE THE ONLY OPPORTUNITY TO PROVIDE
        PUBLIC COMMENT DURING THIS MEETING. A total of three minutes will be provided to each speaker.
        The meeting chair may adjust the amount of time provided. If a speaker is not addressing matters within the
        Ethics Commission’s jurisdiction, the speaker will be asked to conclude. The public is encouraged to submit
        written comments to ethics.commission@lacity.org at least 24 hours prior to the meeting, to help ensure that
        the commissioners have sufficient time to review them.


3.      Minutes for the meeting on February 18, 2026.

4.      Possible discussion with authorized neighborhood council representatives.
        Pursuant to Los Angeles Administrative Code section 22.819, an authorized representative of a
        neighborhood council will have an opportunity to provide the neighborhood council's formal position on a
        matter listed on this meeting agenda within the time allotted by the meeting chair. The neighborhood council
        shall provide the commission with a copy of the Community Impact Statement it filed with the City Clerk or
        the adopted resolution regarding its formal position in advance of this meeting.


Action Items

5.      Review of recusals by Kenneth Buzzell, a member of the Board of Fire and
        Police Pension Commissioners.

6.      Assessment of the matching funds trust fund for the regular 2026 general City
        elections.

7.       Charter-mandated determination regarding the executive director’s salary.

Information Items

8.       Election update.

9.       Lobbying summary (4th quarter 2025)

10.      Lobbying summary (2025 annual overview).

11.      Lobbying summary (1st quarter 2026).

12.      Recusal summary (1st quarter 2026).

13.      Pre-confirmation statements of economic interests.

14.      Policy and legislation update.

15.      Executive director’s report.

Closing Items

16.      President’s appreciation and departing message.

17.      Commissioner announcements and requests to schedule items on future agendas.

18.      Adjournment.


The City does not discriminate on the basis of disability and, upon request, will provide reasonable accommodation to
ensure equal access to its programs, services, and activities. Please make your request for auxiliary aids and
services at least 72 hours before the meeting. Requests for sign language interpreters are strongly recommended at
least five business days before the meeting. Public documents regarding an agenda item that are distributed to a
majority of the commissioners may be viewed during normal business hours at the Ethics Commission’s office. For
additional information, please contact us at (213) 978-1960 or ethics.commission@lacity.org.

      Notice to Paid Representatives: If you are compensated to monitor, attend, or speak at this meeting,
      City law may require you to register as a lobbyist and report your activity. See Los Angeles Municipal
      Code §§ 48.01 et seq. More information is available at ethics.lacity.gov/lobbying. For assistance, please
      contact the Ethics Commission at (213) 978-1960 or ethics.commission@lacity.org.
